ranking_rule: expected DTI gain per unit implementation cost; every candidate measured at matched emitted mass

hypotheses.name: seismicity lineation corridors (OADC on ComCat) + snap to 3DEP scarp ridge
hypotheses.status: LEGACY IMPLEMENTATION; NOT NEW; NOT SLOT-ELIGIBLE
hypotheses.transform: legacy covariance/lineation processing; triangle-area filter is called but its keep mask is not applied to the event arrays subsequently fitted; the builder does not call the separate nearest-neighbour declusterer
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: mapped-trace inventories are geometry; seismicity is process. Epineural lineaments sit 1-4 km off the mapped traces (median 32.7 px) and the catalogue shows 0.8x enrichment within 300 m of events, i.e. no enrichment.
hypotheses.difference: Superseded novelty claim: the 2-D seismicity-lineation family is already implemented in this repository and must not be presented as new. The legacy local proxy is not the frozen H50-S1 blocked holdout.
hypotheses.eligibility: Do not use externally until ComCat rights/shareability, declustering, mine/injection screening, uncertainty, matched smoothed-density controls, and frozen blocked-holdout provenance are resolved.
hypotheses.measurements_status: Historical local proxies only; not an organizer score or authenticated score-to-TIFF mapping.

hypotheses.name: catalogue gap closure and splay continuation
hypotheses.status: LEGACY PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION; NOT AN INDEPENDENT NEW CANDIDATE
hypotheses.transform: bridge corridor endpoints within 1.5 km and <= 40 deg apart at one dot per 300 m
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: much of a hidden fault inventory is extension/splay of mapped structures
hypotheses.difference: the sibling H44 bridges with Euler depth clusters from gravity/magnetics; this bridges with epicentral spines
hypotheses.measurements_status: Historical local project record; not an organizer score.

hypotheses.name: cross-inventory disagreement (SGMC / QFaults traces absent from the catalogue)
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: these are faults mapped by others but omitted from the competition raster
hypotheses.difference: the family used SGMC only as a validation instrument
hypotheses.reason_not_shipped: near-self-fulfilling on the only instrument that can score it; SGMC/QFaults may be the organisers' label source, so emission would be indistinguishable from leakage

hypotheses.name: radiometric ridge lineaments (oriented matched filter on K/Th/U/TC)
hypotheses.status: LEGACY COMPONENT; NOT A DISTINCT NEW CANDIDATE
hypotheses.transform: sum |grad| over four channels (sigma 2 px) -> max over 12 orientations of a 15 px mean
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: K/Th anomalies trace alteration and fluid pathways along faults lacking Quaternary surface expression
hypotheses.difference: the family used raw channel statistics, not an oriented ridge transform

hypotheses.name: cross-strike swath profiling of the 1 m DEM
hypotheses.status: NOT STARTED; PRIOR DEM/SWATH WORK REQUIRES AUDIT BEFORE CLAIMING NOVELTY
hypotheses.transform: per-candidate swath profile normal to strike scored for a persistent monoclinal step
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: metre-scale cumulative scarps exist even where no trace is mapped; swath profiles separate tectonic steps from symmetric local artefacts
hypotheses.difference: nothing in the family profiles across strike

hypotheses.name: focal mechanisms as a strike prior
hypotheses.transform: weight corridors by mechanism strike agreement within 20 deg
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: confirms a lineation is a fault plane
hypotheses.reason_rejected: ~40 mechanisms in the survey (M >= 3.5) versus tens of thousands of events consumed by the detector; each is a catalogue-fault event, biasing the prior toward mapped structures
